title: 第22章残卷入鼎
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
第二日天还没亮透，陈青山就醒了。

    他先没急着出门。

    桌上那份复炼记录还差半页，柳青霜三日内要看。陈青山把炉灰重新拨了拨，拿旧笔蘸墨，在纸上补了几行。

    丑铜胚摆在旁边。

    他写一句，看一眼铜胚，再故意把字写歪些。

    不能太像临时补的。

    也不能太像用心补的。

    这活，比炼铜还烦。

    等到外头有杂役挑水经过，木桶吱呀吱呀响，他才把黑木贡献牌和那张薄纸凭条一起揣进怀里，锁门出屋。

    藏书阁在器峰往主峰去的半道上。

    一座三层木楼，外头看着不大，门口却站着两个执事弟子。木楼檐下挂着一排铜铃，风一吹，声音很细，听得人不太舒服。

    陈青山递上黑木牌和薄纸凭条。

    守门弟子先看牌，又把薄纸对着门边铜铃晃了晃。铜铃没响，只在纸角浮出“外阁临借”四个淡字。

    “陈青山？”

    “是。”

    “周伯院里的？”

    这话问得很随意。

    陈青山却不敢随便答。

    “弟子给周师傅打过下手。”

    守门弟子笑了笑，把牌子和凭条还给他。

    “外阁，只能一楼。内阁楼梯别碰，碰了扣贡献。书页不许撕，抄录另算贡献。临借只抵一册，残页另算。七日不还，照价赔。”

    照价赔。

    陈青山一听这四个字，脚步都轻了些。

    一楼外阁比他想的还大。

    靠门口立着一块木牌，上面刻着价目。

    《青云练气诀·全本》，借阅三百贡献起。

    《小云雨术》《火弹术》《御风术》，一百贡献起。

    《基础炼器总纲》，六十贡献起。

    《初阶控火法》，八十贡献起。

    陈青山站在牌子前，看了好一会儿。

    三十贡献。

    他摸了摸怀里的黑木牌，忽然觉得这牌子有点轻。

    操。

    穷人来藏书阁，连字都看不起。

    管书的是个瘦老头，坐在柜台后头，眼皮耷着，手里捏着一串小算盘。见陈青山还站在价目牌前，他慢悠悠道：“新来的？”

    “嗯。”

    “三十贡献？”

    陈青山一顿。

    “前辈怎么知道？”

    瘦老头拿算盘敲了敲桌面。

    “看你那眼神就知道。头回来外阁的，都先看全本。看完以后，就知道自己该去哪儿了。”

    他说完，往最角落一指。

    “残册区。五贡献一册，残页一贡献三张。残册可借可折买，残页买断，出柜不退。反正那堆东西，狗都不看。”

    陈青山顺着他指的方向看去。

    角落里有两排矮架，灰比书厚。几本册子歪七扭八塞着，有些封皮都没了，只用麻绳草草捆住。

    好地方。

    周伯说得对。

    越没人管，越好糊弄。

    陈青山没再看价目牌，直接去了残册区。

    第一本拿起来，封面只剩半张，写着《控火入门残篇》。打开一看，前面三页被火燎过，后面少了半截，最关键的运火路线断在“过少阳”三个字后头。

    正常人看了，确实没用。

    第二本是《破纹残解》。书页被虫蛀得一排小洞，讲的是断纹、乱纹、假纹，越往后越缺，最后几页只有图，没有字。

    第三堆更惨。

    《基础灵纹三十六式残页》。

    不是册子，就是一叠散页，少了多少张都不知道。
content_en:
Chen Qingshan woke up before it was even bright the next day.

    He was not in a hurry to go out yet.

    There is still half a page left in the refining record on the table, and Liu Qingshuang wants to read it within three days. Chen Qingshan picked up the ashes again, dipped an old pen in ink, and added a few lines on the paper.

    The ugly copper embryo is placed next to it.

    He wrote a sentence, took a look at the copper embryo, and then deliberately wrote the words crookedly.

    It can't be too much of a temporary fix.

    It can’t look too much like it was made with care.

    This work is more troublesome than smelting copper.

    When a handyman passed by carrying water outside and the wooden barrel creaked, he put the black wood contribution sign and the thin paper receipt into his arms, locked the door and left the house.

    The Library Pavilion is halfway from Qi Peak to the main peak.

    It was a three-story wooden building that didn't look very big from the outside, but there were two deacon disciples standing at the door. A row of copper bells hangs under the eaves of the wooden building. When the wind blows, the sound is very thin, which makes people uncomfortable.

    Chen Qingshan handed over the black wooden sign and thin paper receipt.

    The gatekeeper looked at the cards first, then waved the tissue paper against the brass bell by the door. The bell did not ring, and only the four plain words "Outer Pavilion Temporary Borrowing" appeared on the corner of the paper.

    "Chen Qingshan?"

    "Yes."

    "From Zhou Bo's Courtyard?"

    This was a very casual question.

    Chen Qingshan did not dare to answer casually.

    "This disciple has beaten Master Zhou."

    The gatekeeper smiled and returned the sign and receipt to him.

    "The outer cabinet can only be on the first floor. Don't touch the stairs of the cabinet. If you touch the stairs, your contribution will be deducted. The pages of the book are not allowed to be torn. Copying will be counted as an additional contribution. You can only borrow one volume as a temporary loan, and the remaining pages will be counted separately. If you do not return it within seven days, you will be compensated according to the price."

    Compensate according to price.

    When Chen Qingshan heard these four words, his steps became lighter.

    The outer pavilion on the first floor was bigger than he thought.

    There was a wooden sign standing near the door with the price engraved on it.

    "Qingyun Qi Lianjue·Complete Edition", the borrowing fee is 300 yuan.

    "Little Cloud and Rain Technique", "Fire Bullet Technique" and "Wind Control Technique", starting from one hundred contributions.

    "Basic Weapon Refining General Guide", starting from 60 contributions.

    "Basic Fire Control Method", contributed since 80.

    Chen Qingshan stood in front of the sign and looked at it for a long time.

    Thirty contributions.

    He touched the black wooden sign in his arms and suddenly felt that the sign was a little light.

    Hold.

    When poor people come to the library, they can't even read the words.

    The bookkeeper was a thin old man, sitting behind the counter, with drooped eyelids and a bunch of small abacus in his hand. Seeing Chen Qingshan still standing in front of the price list, he said slowly: "New here?"

    "Yeah."

    "Thirty contributions?"

    Chen Qingshan paused.

    "How does senior know?"

    The thin old man tapped the table with his abacus.

    "I can tell by the look in your eyes. Anyone who comes back to the outer cabinet for the first time should read the entire book first. After reading it, you will know where you should go."

    After he finished speaking, he pointed to the far corner.

    "The broken volume area. Five people contribute one volume, and each broken page contributes three. The broken books can be borrowed or bought at a discount, and the broken pages can be bought out and will not be returned after you come out. Anyway, no dog will look at that pile of things."

    Chen Qingshan looked in the direction he pointed.

    There are two rows of low shelves in the corner, the gray is thicker than the books. Several booklets were stuffed crookedly, some of the covers were gone, and they were only tied hastily with hemp rope.

    Great place.

    Uncle Zhou is right.

    The more no one cares about it, the easier it is to fool people.

    Chen Qingshan didn't look at the price tag and went directly to the residual book area.

    When I picked up the first book, only half of the cover was left, which read "An Introduction to Fire Control." When I opened it, I found that the first three pages were burned by fire, and half of the back pages were missing. The most critical fire transportation route was cut off after the three words "Guo Shaoyang".

    Normal people see it and it’s really useless.

    The second book is "Bao Wen Zan Jie". The pages of the book are riddled with moth-eaten holes. They are about broken, random, and false lines, which become increasingly missing as you go to the back. The last few pages contain only pictures and no words.

    The third pile was even worse.

    "Fragmentary Pages of the Thirty-Six Styles of Basic Spirit Patterns".

    It's not a booklet, it's just a stack of loose pages. I don't know how many pages are missing.
title_en: Chapter 22 The remains are rolled into the cauldron
